comment: Smart Data Models - RAMI4.0 Asset Administration Shell (AAS) / I4SubmodelElementCapability adapted to DTDL from smartdatamodels.org. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smart-data-models/dataModel.AAS/master/I4SubmodelElementCapability/schema.json
description: Based on IDTA-01001-3-0, describes a generic RAMI4.0 SubmodelElement representing an Capability of a referenced Asset Administration Shell

contents.name: alternateName
contents.comment: An alternative name for this item

contents.name: areaServed
contents.comment: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided

contents.name: category
contents.comment: The category is a value that gives further meta information w.r.t. to the class of the element

contents.name: dataProvider
contents.comment: A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity

contents.name: dateCreated
contents.comment: Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform

contents.name: dateModified
contents.comment: Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform

contents.name: description
contents.comment: A description of this item

contents.name: idShort
contents.comment: short id is the (short) name of the SubmodelElement within RAMI40 environment

contents.name: kind
contents.comment: For the distinction of 'type' and 'instance', the term 'kind' is used

contents.name: name
contents.comment: The name of this item

contents.name: refI4AASId
contents.comment: References the root Asset Administration Shell which this SubmodelElement belongs to

contents.name: refI4AssetId
contents.comment: References the root Asset which this SubmodelElement belongs to

contents.name: refI4SubmodelId
contents.comment: References the root Submodel which this SubmodelElement belongs to

contents.name: source
contents.comment: A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data as a URL. Recommended to be the fully qualified domain name of the source provider, or the URL to the source object

contents.name: descriptions
contents.comment: For adding detailed knowledge about the Element in different languages

contents.name: hasDataSpecification
contents.comment: Element that can be extended by using data specification templates. A data specification template defines a named set of additional attributes an element may or shall have. RAMI4.0 specification

contents.name: owner
contents.comment: A List containing a JSON encoded sequence of characters referencing the unique Ids of the owner(s)

contents.name: address
contents.comment: The mailing address

contents.name: modelType
contents.comment: For the distinction of 'type' and 'instance', the term 'kind' is used

contents.name: semanticId
contents.comment: It refers to an external information source, which explains the formulation of the submodel element
